system.description:
You are Steeled while wearing armour or operating any vehicle, and armour's Heavy property doesn't affect you.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48
system.summary: You are Steeled while wearing armour or operating any vehicle, and armour's Heavy property doesn't affect you.

when.label: Remove (no armour, not in a vehicle)

automation.note: Use this ability (no action) to become Steeled when you put on armour or operate a vehicle; click the Remove button when you stop. The system still applies Heavy armour's Speed penalty, so undo it by hand.
